_note: Chapter 13 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: Green plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air.
ex.cn: 绿色植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳。
ex.note: be absorbed in 沉浸于；absorb shock 承受冲击

ex.en: After the long climb, my legs ached all evening.
ex.cn: 爬完那段长路后，我的双腿整个晚上都在作痛。
ex.note: ache for sth. 渴望某物；a dull ache 隐隐的疼痛

ex.en: He admitted that he had made a serious mistake.
ex.cn: 他承认自己犯了一个严重的错误。
ex.note: admit sb. to sth. 准许某人进入/参加

ex.en: They left for the mountains a week ago.
ex.cn: 他们一周前出发去山里了。
ex.note: long ago 很久以前；before 比…早

ex.en: Although it was raining, they set out on the hike.
ex.cn: 尽管下着雨，他们还是出发去徒步了。
ex.note: although … but … 虽然…但是…

ex.en: The guide announced that the road would close at six.
ex.cn: 讲解员宣布公路将在六点封闭。
ex.note: announce sth. to sb. 向某人宣布某事

ex.en: She put a red apple on the table and sat down.
ex.cn: 她在桌上放了一个红苹果，然后坐了下来。

ex.en: The police arrested two men that morning.
ex.cn: 那天早上警方逮捕了两个人。
ex.note: arrest the spread of 阻止…蔓延；arrest sb.'s attention 吸引某人的注意

ex.en: He assured us that the path was safe.
ex.cn: 他向我们保证那条路很安全。
ex.note: assure sb. of sth. 使某人对某事确信

ex.en: The doctor was not available until the following morning.
ex.cn: 医生直到第二天早上才有空。
ex.note: be available to sb. 对某人可用；make sth. available 提供某物

ex.en: The nurse put a clean bandage around his ankle.
ex.cn: 护士在他的脚踝上缠了一圈干净的绷带。
ex.note: bandage a wound 包扎伤口

ex.en: They walked barefoot along the beach before breakfast.
ex.cn: 早餐前，他们赤着脚沿沙滩走。
ex.note: on the beach 在沙滩上；beach towel 沙滩巾

ex.en: He put a small gift in his beloved's hands.
ex.cn: 他把一件小礼物放进爱妻的手里。
ex.note: be beloved by 受…喜爱；a beloved son 宠儿

ex.en: A mosquito bite left a red spot on his arm.
ex.cn: 蚊子在他手臂上叮出了一个红点。
ex.note: a bite of 一口；bite off 咬掉

ex.en: The doctor said no bone had been broken.
ex.cn: 医生说没有骨折。
ex.note: have a bone to pick with 与…有矛盾要争

ex.en: A breakdown on the highway delayed them by two hours.
ex.cn: 高速公路上的一次故障让他们迟到了两个小时。
ex.note: a breakdown of the system 体系的崩溃；nervous breakdown 精神崩溃

ex.en: She tied her clothes into a small bundle.
ex.cn: 她把衣服扎成一个小包。
ex.note: a bundle of 一捆/一批；bundle up 捆扎

ex.en: A bowl of hot soup is about two hundred calories.
ex.cn: 一碗热汤大约两百卡路里。
ex.note: calories burned 消耗的热量；low-calorie 低热量的

ex.en: The old carrier plane brings supplies to the remote village each week.
ex.cn: 那架老旧的运输机每周给那个偏远村庄送来物资。
ex.note: a carrier bag 购物袋；a common carrier 公共承运人

ex.en: The city center is very quiet on Sunday mornings.
ex.cn: 星期日早上的市中心十分安静。
ex.note: in the center of 在…的中心；shopping center 购物中心

ex.en: Check the timetable before you leave the station.
ex.cn: 离开车站前先查一下时刻表。
ex.note: check in 登记入住；check out 结账离开

ex.en: The waiter brought the check as soon as we had finished.
ex.cn: 我们一吃完，服务员就把账单拿来了。
ex.note: a blank check 一张空头支票

ex.en: He lit a cigarette outside the office building.
ex.cn: 他在办公楼外点了一支烟。
ex.note: a pack of cigarettes 一包香烟

ex.en: The path ran along the edge of a steep cliff.
ex.cn: 小路沿着陡峭的悬崖边缘延伸。
ex.note: cliff edge 悬崖边缘；cliff fall 坠崖

ex.en: The villagers made a collective decision to refuse the plan.
ex.cn: 村民们集体作出决定，拒绝那个方案。
ex.note: collective action 集体行动；collective responsibility 集体责任

ex.en: The two friends were good company on the long road.
ex.cn: 长途路上，这两个朋友是很好的同伴。
ex.note: in company with 与…一起；keep sb. company 陪伴某人

ex.en: He could not concentrate on his book in the noisy carriage.
ex.cn: 在吵闹的车厢里，他没法专心看书。
ex.note: concentrate on 专注于；concentrate on doing 专心做

ex.en: The conquest of the valley took the army three years.
ex.cn: 征服那片山谷花了这支军队三年时间。
ex.note: the conquest of 征服…；a military conquest 军事征服

ex.en: Read the passage again to see the context of the new word.
ex.cn: 再读一遍这段话，看看这个生词的上下文。
ex.note: in context 在语境中；the context of … …的背景

ex.en: The core of the mountain is made of ancient granite.
ex.cn: 这座山的核心由古老的花岗岩构成。
ex.note: at the core of 在…的核心；core issue 核心问题

ex.en: The team's core belief was that anyone could learn.
ex.cn: 这个团队的核心信念是任何人都能学会。
ex.note: core values 核心价值观；core strength 核心优势

ex.en: My cousin invited me to spend a week in the mountains.
ex.cn: 我表姐邀请我去山里住上一周。
ex.note: first cousin 堂（表）兄弟姐妹

ex.en: The king's crown was kept in a glass case in the hall.
ex.cn: 国王的王冠保存在大厅里的一只玻璃柜中。
ex.note: the crown jewels 王室珠宝；crown prince 王储

ex.en: They crowned the young king in the great hall.
ex.cn: 他们在大会堂为年轻的国王加冕。
ex.note: be crowned king 加冕为王

ex.en: Her dad cried openly at the wedding.
ex.cn: 婚礼上她父亲当众哭了出来。
ex.note: Dad 爸爸（口语）；daddy 老爸

ex.en: He had not visited the coast for a whole decade.
ex.cn: 他有整整十年没去过海边了。
ex.note: for the past decade 过去十年；decades later 许多年后

ex.en: You can delete the message from your phone at any time.
ex.cn: 这条消息你随时可以从手机里删掉。
ex.note: delete a file 删除文件；delete a message 删除信息

ex.en: The old town is a desirable place to live.
ex.cn: 这座老城是个宜居的地方。
ex.note: desirable for 对…来说是可取的；highly desirable 非常可取的

ex.en: The teacher gave a short dictation of new words.
ex.cn: 老师就新单词做了一小段听写。
ex.note: take dictation 做听写；dictation test 听写测验

ex.en: He was disappointed with the result of the exam.
ex.cn: 他对考试的结果很失望。
ex.note: be disappointed in/with 对…失望；disappointed at 对…失望

ex.en: The guide hid her distress and kept walking.
ex.cn: 向导藏起自己的慌张，继续往前走。
ex.note: in distress 处于危难；a distress signal 求救信号

ex.en: The bad news distressed the whole family.
ex.cn: 这个坏消息让全家人都很难过。
ex.note: be deeply distressed 深感悲痛

ex.en: The inn had one double room and two single rooms.
ex.cn: 客栈有一间双人房和两间单人房。
ex.note: double room 双人间；double bed 双人床

ex.en: The company doubled its sales in three years.
ex.cn: 这家公司的销售额三年里翻了一番。
ex.note: double the price 价钱翻倍；double up 折叠

ex.en: A stand-in replaced her, and the double played the leading role that night.
ex.cn: 替身顶上了她，那天晚上由这个替角扮演主角。
ex.note: play double for sb. 为某人做替身

ex.en: A musician played the drum in the corner of the square.
ex.cn: 一位乐手在广场的角落里敲着鼓。
ex.note: drum on sth. 敲打；drum up 鼓动

ex.en: They stopped twice to eat something on the way up.
ex.cn: 上山的路上他们停下来吃了两次东西。
ex.note: eat away 腐蚀；eat up 吃完

ex.en: The villagers will elect a new council in the autumn.
ex.cn: 村民们将在秋天选出新的村委会。
ex.note: elect sb. to do sth. 选举某人担任某职

ex.en: The inn has only one permanent employee.
ex.cn: 客栈只有一名长期雇员。
ex.note: employ 雇用；employer 雇主

ex.en: Mark was enthusiastic about the trip from the very start.
ex.cn: 马克从一开始就对这次旅行兴致勃勃。
ex.note: be enthusiastic about 对…充满热情

ex.en: The village festival was the biggest event of the year.
ex.cn: 村里的节日是那一整年最大的一件事。
ex.note: sports event 体育比赛项目；a charity event 慈善活动

ex.en: It is an exciting trip for anyone who likes mountains.
ex.cn: 对于喜欢山的人来说，这是一趟令人兴奋的旅行。
ex.note: exciting news 激动人心的消息；excitingly different 令人耳目一新

ex.en: Her expression changed when she saw the wound.
ex.cn: 看到那道伤口时，她的表情变了。
ex.note: facial expression 面部表情；an expression of thanks 感谢的表达

ex.en: The village has fame for its silk and cheese.
ex.cn: 这个村子以丝绸和奶酪闻名。
ex.note: win fame 赢得声誉；fame for 因…而闻名

ex.en: He felt a real fear when the lightning struck the ridge.
ex.cn: 闪电劈在山脊上的时候，他感到了真正的恐惧。
ex.note: in fear of 害怕；fear of 对…的恐惧

ex.en: Many people fear the sound of thunder.
ex.cn: 许多人都怕打雷的声音。
ex.note: fear to do 不敢做；fear for 担心

ex.en: A tall figure was waiting for them at the station.
ex.cn: 一个高个子的身影在车站等着他们。
ex.note: a key figure 关键人物；the figures 数字

ex.en: They figured the cost of the trip before setting out.
ex.cn: 出发前他们算出了这趟旅行的开销。
ex.note: figure out 弄明白；figure that… 估计…

ex.en: The soup had little flesh but a fine flavour.
ex.cn: 那汤几乎没什么肉，却味道极好。
ex.note: flesh and blood 血肉之躯；the flesh of the fruit 果肉

ex.en: The force of the storm shook the windows.
ex.cn: 风暴的力量震得窗户直响。
ex.note: by force 靠武力；in force 生效中

ex.en: The wind forced the door open.
ex.cn: 风把门吹开了。
ex.note: force sb. to do sth. 强迫某人做某事；force one's way 强行开路

ex.en: A fragment of the old wall lies beside the path.
ex.cn: 旧城墙的一块碎片躺在路边。
ex.note: a fragment of 一小片；in fragments 支离破碎地

ex.en: The school fund paid for the new books.
ex.cn: 学校基金付了买新书的钱。
ex.note: a fund for … 用于…的基金；raise funds 筹款

ex.en: Local companies funded the restoration of the castle.
ex.cn: 当地企业资助了城堡的修复。
ex.note: fund a project 为项目出资

ex.en: In general, the old castle was well preserved.
ex.cn: 总的来说，这座古堡保存得很好。
ex.note: in general 总的来说；a general idea 大致的想法

ex.en: A general once led the army through the valley.
ex.cn: 有位将军曾率军穿过山谷。
ex.note: army general 陆军将军

ex.en: The doctor used medical glue instead of stitches.
ex.cn: 医生用医用胶代替了缝合线。
ex.note: a tube of glue 一管胶水

ex.en: He glued the broken cup back together.
ex.cn: 他把打碎的杯子重新粘好了。
ex.note: glue sth. to sth. 把某物粘在某物上；be glued to 紧盯着

ex.en: His grandmother was the first teacher in the village.
ex.cn: 他的祖母是村里的第一位老师。
ex.note: maternal grandmother 外祖母；paternal grandmother 祖母

ex.en: All the guests danced in the square until midnight.
ex.cn: 所有的客人都跳舞到半夜。
ex.note: a guest of 客人；guest room 客房

ex.en: The fishing boats returned to the harbor before dark.
ex.cn: 渔船在天黑前回到了港口。
ex.note: in harbor 在港内；a natural harbor 天然港

ex.en: He harbored a secret for years without telling anyone.
ex.cn: 他藏着一个秘密多年，谁也没告诉。
ex.note: harbor fear 心怀恐惧；harbor a hope 心怀希望

ex.en: His heart beat fast as the train began to move.
ex.cn: 火车开始动的时候，他心跳得很快。
ex.note: with all one's heart 全心全地；heart and soul 全心全意

ex.en: They camped on the hill above the village.
ex.cn: 他们在村子上面的小山上扎营。
ex.note: over the hill 翻过山丘；hill country 丘陵地带

ex.en: The lines on the map are all horizontal.
ex.cn: 地图上的线都是水平的。
ex.note: a horizontal line 水平线；horizontal plane 水平面

ex.en: Her husband died on a climbing trip many years ago.
ex.cn: 她丈夫许多年前在一次登山中去世了。
ex.note: husband and wife 夫妻

ex.en: The innkeeper was an immigrant from the east.
ex.cn: 客栈老板是从东边来的移民。
ex.note: an immigrant from 来自…的移民

ex.en: She is an independent woman who makes her own decisions.
ex.cn: 她是个独立自主的女人，做事都由自己决定。
ex.note: be independent of 与…无关；financially independent 经济独立

ex.en: They stayed the night at a small inn in the mountains.
ex.cn: 他们在山里一家小客栈住了一夜。
ex.note: check into an inn 投宿客栈

ex.en: He intended to return the following spring.
ex.cn: 他打算第二年春天再来一趟。
ex.note: intend to do sth. 打算做某事

ex.en: She invited us to spend a week in the mountains.
ex.cn: 她邀请我们去山里住上一周。
ex.note: invite sb. to do sth. 邀请某人做某事

ex.en: The train journey alone was worth the fare.
ex.cn: 单是火车上的旅程就值回票价。
ex.note: a long journey 长途旅行；a journey of a thousand miles 千里之行

ex.en: There was a long kiss at the end of the ceremony.
ex.cn: 仪式结束时有一个长久的吻。
ex.note: kiss sb. goodbye 亲吻告别

ex.en: They took the last train on Friday evening.
ex.cn: 他们搭了周五傍晚最后一班火车。
ex.note: the last minute 最后时刻；last but not least 最后但同样重要

ex.en: The storm lasted two whole days.
ex.cn: 暴风雨整整持续了两天。
ex.note: last for 持续；last a month 持续一个月

ex.en: She walked past the harbor one last time.
ex.cn: 她最后一次从港口旁走过。
ex.note: at last 终于；last of all 最后

ex.en: He wore a leather jacket to the wedding.
ex.cn: 他穿着皮夹克去参加婚礼。
ex.note: leather goods 皮制品

ex.en: Lightning struck the ridge just after noon.
ex.cn: 正午刚过，一道闪电劈在山脊上。
ex.note: a flash of lightning 一道闪电；lightning rod 避雷针

ex.en: The inn stands in a good location above the valley.
ex.cn: 客栈坐落在山谷上方一个很好的位置。
ex.note: in a convenient location 位置便利

ex.en: His lungs were not used to the high altitude.
ex.cn: 他的肺还不适应这么高的海拔。
ex.note: lung cancer 肺癌；a lung of air 一口气

ex.en: This factory manufactures parts for cars.
ex.cn: 这家工厂制造汽车零件。
ex.note: manufacture goods 生产商品；the manufacturing industry 制造业

ex.en: The village had little manufacture of its own.
ex.cn: 村里自己几乎没有什么制造业。
ex.note: the manufacture of goods 商品的生产

ex.en: What did you mean by that remark?
ex.cn: 你那句话是什么意思？
ex.note: mean to do 打算做；I mean 我的意思是

ex.en: He was too mean to buy anyone a gift.
ex.cn: 他小气得连礼物都不肯给人买。
ex.note: mean about 在…上很吝啬

ex.en: The whole village was merry that evening.
ex.cn: 那天晚上全村人喜气洋洋。
ex.note: merry 圣诞节 圣诞快乐

ex.en: He felt miserable after losing the final.
ex.cn: 输了决赛之后他很难受。
ex.note: miserable weather 糟糕的天气

ex.en: The view from the top of the hill was more beautiful than any photograph.
ex.cn: 山顶的景色比任何照片都更美。
ex.note: more and more 越来越；no more 不再

ex.en: A musician played the drum at the village wedding.
ex.cn: 乡村婚礼上，一位乐手敲着鼓。
ex.note: a street musician 街头艺人

ex.en: The bride wore a silver necklace made by a local craftsman.
ex.cn: 新娘戴着一条当地工匠做的银项链。
ex.note: a necklace of pearls 一条珍珠项链

ex.en: The soil in the valley is rich in nitrogen.
ex.cn: 山谷里的土壤富含氮。
ex.note: nitrogen dioxide 二氧化氮

ex.en: The plan for a nuclear test was stopped by public protest.
ex.cn: 进行核试验的计划被公众抗议叫停了。
ex.note: nuclear power 核能；nuclear family 核心家庭

ex.en: The castle was once the center of a small kingdom.
ex.cn: 这座城堡曾经是一个小王国的中心。
ex.note: a friend of mine 我的一个朋友；out of 在…之外

ex.en: He saw an opportunity to return and meant to take it.
ex.cn: 他看到了一次回来的机会，打算抓住它。
ex.note: an opportunity to do sth. 做某事的机会；take the opportunity 把握机会

ex.en: Sarah loved the outdoors and often hiked at weekends.
ex.cn: 萨拉热爱户外，周末常去徒步。
ex.note: go outdoors 到户外去；the great outdoors 大自然

ex.en: A page from an old dictionary lay in the glass case.
ex.cn: 玻璃柜里放着一页旧词典。
ex.note: turn the pages 翻页；a full page 整页

ex.en: The story was partly history and partly legend.
ex.cn: 这个故事一部分是史实，一部分是传说。
ex.note: partly because of 部分由于

ex.en: The village had a peculiar custom of burning written wishes.
ex.cn: 这个村子有一种焚烧书面心愿的奇特风俗。
ex.note: peculiar to … …所特有的

ex.en: He was pessimistic about the weather that winter.
ex.cn: 那年冬天他对天气很不乐观。
ex.note: pessimistic about 对…悲观；a pessimistic view 悲观的看法

ex.en: The air smelled of pine and wild violet.
ex.cn: 空气里满是松木和野紫罗兰的气味。
ex.note: pine forest 松林；a pine tree 一棵松树

ex.en: A poet once wrote a long poem about the castle.
ex.cn: 有位诗人曾写过一首咏城堡的长诗。
ex.note: a classical poet 古典诗人

ex.en: A portrait of the king hung in the great hall.
ex.cn: 大厅里挂着国王的肖像。
ex.note: paint a portrait 画肖像；a self-portrait 自画像

ex.en: The necklace was too precious to be sold.
ex.cn: 那条项链太珍贵，卖不得。
ex.note: precious metals 贵金属；precious memories 珍贵的回忆

ex.en: The guide told them about the castle and its princess.
ex.cn: 讲解员讲起了这座城堡和它的公主。
ex.note: crown princess 王储

ex.en: The children showed them a project about the local birds.
ex.cn: 孩子们给他们看了一个关于本地鸟类的项目。
ex.note: a school project 学校的课题；a research project 研究项目

ex.en: He projected the sales figures for the next year.
ex.cn: 他预测了明年的销售数字。
ex.note: project that… 预计…

ex.en: The small school had never had any publicity.
ex.cn: 这所小学校从来没有做过任何宣传。
ex.note: publicity for 为…做宣传；media publicity 媒体宣传

ex.en: She quit smoking years ago but still misses it.
ex.cn: 她多年前就戒了烟，可偶尔还是会想念。
ex.note: quit doing sth. 停止做某事；quit a job 辞职

ex.en: They reached the top of the hill at four in the afternoon.
ex.cn: 他们下午四点登上了山顶。
ex.note: reach out 伸出手；reach a decision 做出决定

ex.en: The old book is within easy reach of the library.
ex.cn: 那本旧书离图书馆伸手可及。
ex.note: within reach 触手可及；out of reach 无法够到

ex.en: He recovered slowly after the fall.
ex.cn: 摔伤之后他恢复得很慢。
ex.note: recover from 从…中恢复

ex.en: The old legend was closely related to the lost necklace.
ex.cn: 那段古老的传说与那条失踪的项链密切相关。
ex.note: be related to 与…有关；be related to sb. 与…有亲属关系

ex.en: She asked a question, but the teacher did not reply.
ex.cn: 她问了一个问题，老师却没有回答。
ex.note: reply to 答复；in reply 作为答复

ex.en: The guide was responsible for everyone's safety.
ex.cn: 向导对所有人的安全负责。
ex.note: be responsible for 对…负责

ex.en: The old school rules were too rigid for a modern class.
ex.cn: 那些旧校规对现代班级来说太死板了。
ex.note: rigid rules 死板的规则；a rigid body 刚体

ex.en: It was a royal fortress, and the crown was kept in the hall.
ex.cn: 那是一座王室的堡垒，王冠就存放在大厅里。
ex.note: the royal family 王室；royal blood 王族血统

ex.en: The laboratory received a sample of the soil last week.
ex.cn: 实验室上周收到了一份土壤样本。
ex.note: a sample of 一份样本；a free sample 免费样品

ex.en: She sampled the cheese before buying a whole wheel.
ex.cn: 她先尝了尝奶酪，才买了一整轮。
ex.note: sample the wine 品尝葡萄酒

ex.en: The little school in the village had only twenty pupils.
ex.cn: 村里那所小学校只有二十名学生。
ex.note: primary school 小学；a school of thought 学派

ex.en: They went down to the ranger to seek help.
ex.cn: 他们下到山脚去找护林员求助。
ex.note: seek help 求助；seek after 追求

ex.en: They walked for seven hours without a proper rest.
ex.cn: 他们走了七个小时，中间没好好歇过。
ex.note: seven days 一周；at seven o'clock 在七点

ex.en: The man was arrested for shooting protected birds.
ex.cn: 那个人因为猎杀受保护的鸟类而被逮捕。
ex.note: shoot at 朝…射击；shoot a film 拍电影

ex.en: The plants put out a new shoot after the rain.
ex.cn: 雨后植物又抽出了一根新芽。
ex.note: a new shoot 一根新芽

ex.en: The village had fame for its silk.
ex.cn: 这个村子以丝绸闻名。
ex.note: a silk scarf 一条丝巾；made of silk 丝绸制成

ex.en: He skipped the last part of the climb and waited below.
ex.cn: 他跳过了最后一段上山的路，在下面等着。
ex.note: skip breakfast 不吃早饭；skip stones 打水漂

ex.en: An eagle soared above the rocks on the ridge.
ex.cn: 一只鹰在山脊的岩石上方盘旋。
ex.note: soar to new heights 飞向新的高度

ex.en: His shoulders were sore after the long climb.
ex.cn: 爬了那么久，他肩膀又酸又痛。
ex.note: a sore throat 喉咙痛；feel sore 感到酸痛

ex.en: The nurse cleaned the sore on his arm and bandaged it.
ex.cn: 护士清理了他手臂上的伤处，并给它包扎好。
ex.note: an open sore 敞开的疮口

ex.en: The guide gave a short speech about the old legend.
ex.cn: 讲解员就那段古老的传说简短地讲了几句。
ex.note: make a speech 演讲；a public speech 公开演说

ex.en: The inn employed one permanent member of staff.
ex.cn: 客栈只雇着一名长期职员。
ex.note: on the staff 在职；staff room 员工休息室

ex.en: The school was staffed by two young teachers.
ex.cn: 这所学校只有两名年轻教师在任教。
ex.note: be staffed with 由…配备人员

ex.en: He tied a stick to his leg so that he could walk.
ex.cn: 他往腿上绑了根木棍，好让自己能走。
ex.note: a walking stick 手杖

ex.en: He decided to stick to his plan even after the weather turned bad.
ex.cn: 即使天气变坏，他仍决定坚持自己的计划。
ex.note: stick to 坚持；stick sth. on 把…贴上

ex.en: The trip strengthened the bond between the three friends.
ex.cn: 这趟旅行加深了这三个朋友之间的情谊。
ex.note: strengthen one's confidence 增强信心

ex.en: It was a wise and worthy journey, but such a short one.
ex.cn: 这是一段明智而值得的旅程，只是太短了。
ex.note: such as 例如；such a… 如此…的

ex.en: The village supplied its water from the stream above.
ex.cn: 村里的用水取自上面那条溪流。
ex.note: supply sb. with sth. 向…供应某物

ex.en: They carried a week's supply of food on the hike.
ex.cn: 徒步时他们带了一星期的干粮。
ex.note: supplies 补给品；in short supply 供应不足

ex.en: She turned on the lamp with a small switch by the door.
ex.cn: 她按下门边一个小小的开关，打开了灯。
ex.note: a light switch 电灯开关；an on/off switch 开关

ex.en: He switched on the radio to hear the weather report.
ex.cn: 他打开收音机听天气预报。
ex.note: switch to 切换到；switch off 关掉

ex.en: A rescue team came up the mountain before noon.
ex.cn: 一支救援队在中午之前赶到了山上。
ex.note: a team of 一队；team up 合作

ex.en: He felt a real terror when the storm broke.
ex.cn: 暴风雨来临时，他感到了真正的恐怖。
ex.note: in terror 惊恐地；a terror of 对…的强烈恐惧

ex.en: The children listened, and their thinking was quick.
ex.cn: 孩子们听得入神，脑子也转得快。
ex.note: thinking of 想着；a way of thinking 思维方式

ex.en: He tied a stick to his injured leg.
ex.cn: 他把一根木棍绑在受伤的腿上。
ex.note: tie up 捆住；tie a knot 打结

ex.en: The groom wore a red tie with his leather jacket.
ex.cn: 新郎穿着皮夹克，系着一条红领带。
ex.note: a bow tie 领结；a necktie 领带

ex.en: The inn was too small to hold the whole group.
ex.cn: 客栈太小，容不下整群人。
ex.note: too … to do … 太…以至于不能…；not too 并不太

ex.en: The letter was a careful translation of the king's speech.
ex.cn: 那封信是国王讲话的精确译文。
ex.note: a translation of … …的译本；machine translation 机器翻译

ex.en: The story was partly history and partly legend, but it felt true.
ex.cn: 这个故事一半是史实，一半是传说，可听来却像真的一样。
ex.note: true to 忠于；come true 实现

ex.en: They rested for a while under a wide stone arch.
ex.cn: 他们在一道宽大的石拱下歇了一会儿。
ex.note: under control 受控制；under pressure 在压力下

ex.en: Upon his arrival, he called the office to ask for directions.
ex.cn: 一抵达，他就给办公室打电话问路。
ex.note: once upon a time 很久很久以前；upon my word 我保证

ex.en: The mountains slowly vanished behind the clouds.
ex.cn: 群山在云后渐渐消失。
ex.note: vanish into thin air 消失得无影无踪

ex.en: A bunch of violets stood on the windowsill.
ex.cn: 窗台上摆着一束紫罗兰。
ex.note: a violet 一朵紫罗兰；violet perfume 紫罗兰香水

ex.en: She wore a violet dress to the evening party.
ex.cn: 她穿着一件紫罗兰色的裙子去参加晚会。
ex.note: violet light 紫光；violet rays 紫射线

ex.en: Most guests wake early to watch the sunrise from the ridge.
ex.cn: 大多数客人都早早醒来，为的是在山脊上看日出。
ex.note: wake up 醒来；wake sb. up 叫醒某人

ex.en: The whole village came to the wedding in the square.
ex.cn: 全村人都到广场上参加这场婚礼。
ex.note: attend a wedding 参加婚礼；a wedding ring 婚戒

ex.en: The journey was short, while the memories will last for years.
ex.cn: 旅程很短，而那些回忆会留存多年。
ex.note: while 引导对比；even while 尽管

ex.en: We waited for the bus for a short while.
ex.cn: 我们等了一小会儿公交车。
ex.note: for a while 暂时；a while later 过了一会儿

ex.en: Going to the mountains was a wise decision.
ex.cn: 去山里是个明智的决定。
ex.note: wiser than 更明智；no one is wise enough 谁都不够聪明

ex.en: It was a worthy journey, though it was much too short.
ex.cn: 那是一段值得一走的旅程，尽管实在太短。
ex.note: be worthy of 配得上；worthy of praise 值得称赞

ex.en: The highest hill in the zone took them two days to climb.
ex.cn: 这一带最高的那座山让他们花了两天才爬上去。
ex.note: time zone 时区；the free trade zone 自由贸易区
